Messages.Author: John Keech
Messages.Body:
I'm not too sure on this subject, but isn't Illusions of the Kindred a
Combat card? The new vampire burns (or otherwise disappears) after
combat, so she doesn't get her chance to contribute her votes to a new
referendum. Even if she did manage to diablerise in a combat, a blood
hunt would be pointless, as she is about to be removed from play (or
even the game) in any case...

Bearing this in mind, if you are going to use Arika to diablerise
minions in combat then I would weight the deck towards using lots of
Ritual of the bitter rose...

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
On Fri, 18 Apr 2003 23:12:17 +0200, "Kulaid"
<kulaid.ne...@web2news.net> wrote:

>Illusions states that titles don't contest... But what if you wanna use
>the votes?

You can't vote during combat.

>IE you amaranth with an illusions... Can you use the votes
>to burn the illusions rather then have him POOF?

No.
As soon as the amaranth resolves, the combat ends and the vampire is
removed. There is no blood hunt opportunity on illusionary vampires.

>If arika sends somebody to torpor and lived...
>And you play Amaranth, can you use the illusion's votes... PLUS the
>real arika's votes to vote her burnt in the blood hunt?!?

No.

Carpe noctem.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
John Keech wrote:
> I'm not too sure on this subject, but isn't Illusions of the Kindred a
> Combat card? The new vampire burns (or otherwise disappears) after
> combat, so she doesn't get her chance to contribute her votes to a new
> referendum. Even if she did manage to diablerise in a combat, a blood
> hunt would be pointless, as she is about to be removed from play (or
> even the game) in any case...

The blood hunt referendum in the case of Amaranth is handled in combat
(but separate from the combat). Just like the referendum for a blood
hunt from a diablerie action is handled in the action (but separate
from the action).
[LSJ 09-AUG-2001]
http://groups.google.com/groups?selm=3B72E442.38D6C555%40white-wolf.com

It's not pointless if you can benefit from the vampire being the ash heap.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Kulaid wrote:
> I've been doing a google search on this subject...
>
> Illusions states that titles don't contest... But what if you wanna use
> the votes? IE you amaranth with an illusions... Can you use the votes
> to burn the illusions rather then have him POOF? Especially if it's a
> title you already have?

You can use them, even if the title duplicates a contestable one that one
of your other vampires holds. The titles don't contest, as you note.

You can cast them to burn the diablerist or to save him, your choice.

If he burns in the blood hunt, then he doesn't get removed from the game
at the end of combat.
